title: Pre-start chiller 2 before the job
how: Turn on the manual chiller 2 start override (MAN_C2) at least 2 minutes before the job starts. A chiller needs about 45 s to start and 2 minutes to reach full capacity, so the second chiller is carrying load when the ramp arrives.

title: Start the job in two stages
how: Ask the scheduler to start the job at about half power for 4 minutes, then go to full power, so the plant can stage chiller 2 in first.
